info.description:
The Bulk Data Insertion API (BDIA) allows clients to upload server call data into Adobe Analytics in batches of files. 

 The `https://analytics-collection.adobe.io` host automatically routes calls to the best region for processing. If you are legally required to process data in a specific region, use `https://analytics-collection-us.adobe.io` (US) or `https://analytics-collection-eu.adobe.io` (Europe). 

 Note: Adobe may add optional request and response members (name/value pairs) to existing API objects at any time and without notice or changes in versioning. Adobe recommends that you refer to the API documentation of any third-party tool you integrate with our APIs so that such additions are ignored in processing if not understood. If implemented properly, such additions are non-breaking changes for your implementation. Adobe will not remove parameters or add required parameters without first providing standard notification through release notes.
info.title: Bulk Data Insertion API (BDIA)

authorization.name: Authorization
authorization.description: The access token from your OAuth Server-to-Server credential, prefixed with "Bearer ".

x-api-key.name: x-api-key
x-api-key.description: The Client ID (API key) from your OAuth Server-to-Server credential in the Adobe Developer Console.

post.description:
Upload a batch file to Analytics for processing. Uploaded files must:
 * Be 100 MB or less compressed (using gzip)
* Follow the CSV formatting rules and include the required fields as specified in the documentation

parameters.name: x-adobe-vgid
parameters.description: Visitor Group ID. A visitor group represents a bucketed group of visitor IDs that are separate from any other visitor group set. The Group ID is a string of any valid value, but must be consistent across files. See [Visitor groups](https://developer.adobe.com/analytics-collection-apis/endpoints/bulk-data-insertion/visitor-groups/) for more information.

parameters.name: x-adobe-idempotency-key
parameters.description: Optional. A client-generated unique reference for the upload, used for duplication protection when a request does not return a response. If omitted, it defaults to the generated file_id.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Gzip compressed CSV file sent with request

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Store debug information for the first 10 hits of the file

post.description: Upload a batch file for Analytics validation. This file is not stored on the server or processed into Analytics. Validation is only for testing file format.

parameters.name: x-adobe-vgid
parameters.description: Visitor Group ID. See [Visitor groups](https://developer.adobe.com/analytics-collection-apis/endpoints/bulk-data-insertion/visitor-groups/) for more information.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Gzip compressed CSV file sent with request

get.summary: Look up a file by idempotency key
get.description: Verify whether a file was received by Adobe. Use this endpoint when a POST to the events endpoint does not return a response, to check whether the upload was received before resubmitting it.

parameters.name: idempotency_key
parameters.description: The idempotency key supplied with the original upload (the x-adobe-idempotency-key value), or the generated file_id if no key was supplied.

success.description: A success message for validation requests

error.example: File has 2 rows that do not conform to the required CSV format! (Ex: row #59)
error.description: The reason a file failed validation

file_id.description: The file ID as a GUID

size.description: The size of the compressed file in bytes

received_date.description: The date the file was received, in unix epoch time

rows.description: The number of rows in the file

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key used to look up the file

file_id.description: The file ID as a GUID

visitor_group_id.description: The visitor group of the file

size.description: The size of the compressed file in bytes

received_date.description: The date the file was uploaded in unix epoch time.

rows.description: The number of rows in the file

invalid_rows.description: The number of rows not submitted to analytics for being invalid

upload_name.description: The file name as it was uploaded

status_code.description: The status of the file as a short name

idempotency_key.description: Either the value of the x-adobe-idempotency-key if supplied, or the file_id

error.description: An error message for unsuccessful requests
